blog: Haridwar is one of the holiest cities in India, located on the banks of the sacred River Ganga in Uttarakhand. Known as the 'Gateway to the Gods', the city attracts millions of pilgrims who come to seek blessings, take a holy dip in the Ganges, and attend the famous Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. Major attractions include Har Ki Pauri, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Bharat Mata Mandir, and various ancient ghats and ashrams. Haridwar is also an important center for yoga, spirituality, Hindu traditions, and religious festivals such as the Kumbh Mela. With its spiritual atmosphere, sacred rituals, rich cultural heritage, and scenic riverside setting, Haridwar remains one of India's most significant pilgrimage destinations.
